entry.title: btc-verified October Update: Connecting Map to Territory
entry.summary:
Rob recently allocated resources to explore the feasibility of formal equivalence proofs for script engines. Although limited progress was achieved within the constraints of available computational tokens, initial work has commenced and is accessible on [GitHub](https://github.com/Rob1Ham/btc-lean/pull/29). This repository offers a foundation for further development and could be substantially expanded with additional effort.
The current methodology employs a proof system that relies on demonstrating equivalence at the level of LLVM Intermediate Representation (IR), rather than taking a more formalized approach directly tied to C++. This strategy reflects the absence of an established framework for rigorous formal verification in C++ environments. The choice of LLVM IR aims to facilitate comparison and verification across different script engine implementations by providing a common, lower-level representation.
